traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and detailed requirements in docs/stories/020.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION.story.md are implemented and verified. The require-test-traceability ESLint rule enforces file-level @supports annotations, describe() story references, and [REQ-XXX] test name prefixes specifically for test files, with configurable patterns and safe auto-fixes. It is fully integrated into the plugin’s recommended/strict configs, documented in user-docs/api-reference.md, and thoroughly tested in tests/rules/require-test-traceability.test.ts, which passes in the current Jest test run. Therefore, this story is fully implemented and in a passing state.
